title: cURL to Code Converter
description: Turn any cURL command into production-ready test code in seconds — not hours.

caseStudy.problem: API testers spent 2-3 hours/day manually converting cURL to code.
caseStudy.solution: Intelligent parser auto-generates code in 5+ languages with error handling baked in.
results: 40% faster onboarding for new team members

title: API Automation Code Generator
description: Auto-generate 95%-coverage API test suites from OpenAPI specs — in hours, not weeks.

caseStudy.problem: Manual API test creation took 5-7 days per microservice with inconsistent patterns.
caseStudy.solution: Parses OpenAPI specs to generate full test suites with positive/negative cases + auth.
results: Eliminated human error in test case design

title: BDD Framework with CI/CD
description: Zero-touch test execution and real-time quality dashboards for stakeholders.

caseStudy.problem: Manual test runs and reporting consumed 8-10 hours/sprint with no real-time visibility.
caseStudy.solution: BDD framework with Jenkins/GitHub Actions CI/CD and auto-deployed HTML reports.
results: Zero manual intervention in test execution
Real-time test results accessible to all stakeholders

title: Enterprise TDD Framework
description: Battle-tested framework with 95% test stability — adopted across 5 product teams.

caseStudy.problem: Existing test automation was brittle, with 60% of tests failing due to UI changes. Maintenance consumed 40% of QA team's time.
caseStudy.solution: Architected enterprise-grade framework using Page Object Model, Factory pattern, and data-driven approach. Implemented smart element waiting strategies and comprehensive reporting.
results: Test execution parallelization reduced runtime by 75%
